title: On the Stability of Leading-Power Factorization under Photon Propagator Numerator Modifications
summary: We study collinear factorization in strong electromagnetic backgrounds within SCET for a class of modifications where the photon propagator keeps the vacuum pole structure and $i\varepsilon$ prescription, while the background enters only through a numerator tensor $Δ_{μν}(k)$. We show that the set of Landau pinch surfaces and leading momentum regions is unchanged, so the leading-power (LP) factorized form is preserved.
